measurement_notes: Precision/recall measure stored fact observations, including repeat checkpoints; answers are excluded from their TP/FP counts.
Source support includes both stored facts and answer assertions, plus question-specific supporting IDs and exact gold-span containment.
Known and unknown denominators use expected labels, not question-id naming: kk-054-known expects abstention after group forget.
No denominator-free value is called 0% or 100%; unexecuted languages have null metrics.
No timing or cost claim comes from synthetic-clock p95=2 or scorer NOT_PROVIDED cost; provider billing evidence is the immutable ledger.
